All output was written outside the repository and nothing was modified. Filed SEPARATELY from BUG-016 and explicitly not merged with it: pipeline run 32651572136 accounts for all 708 of its tests as passes or failures, so no teardown loss occurred there and this defect cannot explain that red gate.
